=== TWIN.REAL Genuine longitudinal viewing ===

=== SIM.OBS Observation simulation ===
 Timestamped labs, vitals, symptoms, imaging geometry, notes, irregular sampling and missingness. 
Sources: SIM,DATA
  <-- IMPLEMENTS D.SIM Synthetic longitudinal engine
  <-- HAS_STEP WF.SIM Synthetic scenario vertical slice
  <-- WORKFLOW_PRECEDES SIM.LATENT Latent evolution state
  --> WORKFLOW_PRECEDES IMG.SYNMESH Synthetic lesion geometry

=== AI.FUSE Late multimodal fusion ===
 Combine imaging, labs, vitals, symptoms, notes, treatment and missingness with provenance, conflict status. 
Sources: AI,SAF
  <-- IMPLEMENTS D.AI Multimodal intelligence
  <-- PRECEDES AI.NLP Clinical note extraction
  <-- PRECEDES AI.FEAT Deterministic multimodal features
  --> PRECEDES AI.LLM Grounded explanation
  <-- HAS_STEP WF.AI Evidence linked interpretation
  <-- WORKFLOW_PRECEDES AI.FEAT Deterministic multimodal features
  --> WORKFLOW_PRECEDES AI.RETR Evidence retrieval

=== INF.OBJECT Imaging/object storage ===
 Private originals, derivatives, meshes, signed read paths and checksums. 
Sources: ARCH,API,ROAD
  <-- IMPLEMENTS D.INFRA Platform infrastructure
  <-- CONSTRAINS GOV.PRIV Privacy and access

=== INF.JOBS Async imaging jobs ===
 Bounded-memory CPU preparation, remote GPU when needed, status, retry and idempotence. 
Sources: ARCH,API,ROAD
  <-- IMPLEMENTS D.INFRA Platform infrastructure

=== EVAL.SEG Imaging segmentation metrics ===
 Dice, HD95, measured volume error on relevant held-out expert masks, no unsupported claims. 
Sources: TEST
  <-- TESTS D.EVAL Scientific evaluation
  --> VERIFIES IMG.MODEL Optional automated segmentation

=== REF.IDC IDC Index ===
 Reproducible imaging manifests and subset acquisition. 
Sources: REF
